title: Hoyoung — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 16400, 16410, 16411, 16412, 16414; WZ API for 5th job skills and HEXA cores)

skills.name: Talisman Energy
skills.description:
Successful hits with your Heaven, Earth, and Humanity skills charge your Talisman Energy, up to a maximum of 100. You can use Talisman Energy to use Talisman skills.
Right-click to toggle the visual effect for Talisman Energy's full charge.

skills.name: Light Steps
skills.description: Harnesses mind-over-matter to make your body light and swift.

skills.name: Shrouding Mist
skills.description: Protects you from enemy attacks as though you were enshrouded in mist.

skills.name: Humanity: As-You-Will Fan
skills.description: [Humanity Skill] Swings a massive fan. Enemies hit directly by the fan take greater damage.

skills.name: Talisman: Evil-Sealing Gourd
skills.description:
[Talisman Skill] Summons a gourd that sucks up enemies. Press the skill key a second time to launch any enemies captured by the gourd.
Cannot swallow boss monsters, stationary monsters, or enemies 11+ levels higher than you. If you wait too long after sucking up enemies, you will be unable to launch them from the gourd.

skills.name: Graceful Flight
skills.description:
Leap with such grace that you could balance on a single blade of grass. Use while midair to jump. Can be used twice before touching the ground again.
When Graceful Flight is used to jump up, Nimbus Cloud's flight time is limited.
If the Nimbus Cloud lock command feature is active, it can be used with the up arrow key to move up.
The jump distance and height increase with the skill level.

skills.name: Nimbus Cloud
skills.description:
You faced a great trial and gained the power to summon the Nimbus Cloud.
Hold down the skill key while airborne or hold down the up arrow and jump keys together to mount the Nimbus Cloud. While on the Nimbus Cloud, use the arrow keys to fly.
Flight time decreases when used after Graceful Flight up is used.
Right-click to lock command.

skills.name: Swift Sally
skills.description: Swiftly charge forwards like a wind cutting through the fog and attacks enemies ahead of you.

skills.name: Ground-Shattering Wave (Clone/True)
skills.description:
This skill shares its skill level with Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave.. Ride a shockwave to charge forward.

Ground-Shattering Wave (Clone) is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Out of Sight
skills.description: After a clone attack, hide yourself in darkness. While hidden, you cannot be hit by enemies. Using an attack skill will reveal you. Using attack skills will not reveal you (excludes class-wide skills).

skills.name: Ritual Fan Mastery
skills.description: Increases Fan Mastery and Attack Power.

skills.name: Third Eye
skills.description: Opens your mind's eye, allowing you to see through the enemies' weaknesses.

skills.name: Heavenly Body
skills.description: Attunes your bodies to the heavens, granting greater control over Nimbus Cloud.

skills.name: Fortune Fitness
skills.description: Your fitness increases Luck and Final Damage.

skills.name: Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave
skills.description:
[Earth Skill] Kicks the ground to unleash a shockwave along the surface.
After casting, press the forward arrow key and the skill key again to link into Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave (True), charging forward. If you do not do this, it will link into Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave (Clone) instead.
With Action Customization enabled, link into Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave (True) by double-tapping the forward arrow key.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization on/off.

skills.name: Talisman: Clone
skills.description:
[Talisman Skill] Conjures a clone to trick enemies with sly attacks. For the duration of this skill, when you attack enemies, a clone will appear and attack nearby enemies.
Attacks from installation skills or summoned minions will not create a clone. Talisman: Clone is unaffected by attack reflection, and targets the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Ritual Fan Acceleration
skills.description: Uses MP to increase the attack speed of your Ritual Fan for a short time.

skills.name: Out of Sight
skills.description: After a clone attack, hide yourself in darkness. While hidden, you cannot be hit by enemies. Using an attack skill will reveal you.

skills.name: Iron Fan Gale (Clone/True)
skills.description:
This skill shares its skill level with Heaven: Iron Fan Gale.. After using Heaven: Iron Fan Gale, leaps forward to stomp on enemies.
A successful Iron Fan Gale (True) attack will cause you to rebound off the enemy back into the air.

Iron Fan Gale (Clone) is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Stone Tremor (Clone/True)
skills.description:
This skill shares its skill level with arth: Stone Tremor. After using Earth: Stone Tremor, teleports to one end of the rock outcropping and shatters it.
When using Stone Tremor (True), you can use the arrow keys to select whether you move left or right. When using Stone Tremor (Clone), you will only move forward.
Stone Tremor (Clone) is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Attainment
skills.description: Cultivates a deep understanding to increase the damage of your skills.

skills.name: Asura
skills.description: Learn the battle techniques of the Asura.

skills.name: Diamond Body
skills.description: Makes your body unbreakable like diamond.

skills.name: Balanced Breath
skills.description: Achieves balance between Heaven, Earth, and Humanity through your breathing. Restores HP and MP whenever you get your attribute combo to stage 3.

skills.name: Scroll Energy
skills.description:
Your master's spell book has taught you to use Scroll Skills.
Successful hits with your Heaven, Earth, and Humanity skills, or use of Talisman Skills, will earn you croll Energy, which powers your Scroll Skills.

ou can hold a maximum of 900 Scroll Energy.

skills.name: Heaven: Iron Fan Gale
skills.description:
[Heaven Skill] Summons a giant fan to blow a gale downward.
Press the forward key and the skill key again to use Iron Fan Gale (True), leaping forward. Otherwise, this skill will link into Iron Fan Gale (Clone), sending a clone to attack.
With Action Customization enabled, link into Iron Fan Gale (True) by double-tapping the forward arrow key.
This skill's attack speed cannot be increased beyond a set value.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization on/off.

skills.name: Earth: Stone Tremor
skills.description:
[Earth Skill] Slam the ground hard, causing massive stones to jut out from the earth.
Press the Left or Right Arrow key along with the skill key again to link into Stone Tremor (True), charging in that direction. If you do not link into Stone Tremor (True), it will link into Stone Tremor (Clone) and send a clone to attack, instead.

skills.name: Talisman: Seeking Ghost Flame
skills.description:
[Talisman Skill] Conjures a living flame to chase and attack enemies. The flame attacks a target, pauses in place, and then finds a new target to attack.
eeking Ghost Flame is unaffected by attack reflection, and targets the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Scroll: Degeneration
skills.description: [Scroll Skill] A mysterious light shines from your scroll, transforming enemies into frogs, bugs, and other vermin. When the light touches an enemy, it is reflected onto other nearby enemies, transforming a multitude of enemies. Boss monsters cannot be transformed.

skills.name: Consuming Flames (Clone/True)
skills.description:
This skill shares its skill level with eaven: Consuming Flames. After using Heaven: Consuming Flames, soars into the air and creates a burst of fire.

onsuming Flames (Clone) is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Advanced Ritual Fan Mastery
skills.description: Increases Ritual Fan Mastery, Attack Power, and Final Damage.

skills.name: Enlightenment
skills.description: Master the inner workings of your techniques.

skills.name: Dragon's Eye
skills.description: When painting a dragon, the eyes are the final touch that brings it to life. So have you put the final touch on your training.

skills.name: Empowered Harmony
skills.description: Increases the damage of Humanity: As-You-Will Fan, Ground-Shattering Wave skills, Iron Fan Gale skills, Stone Tremor skills, Consuming Flames skills, and Humanity: Gold-Banded Cudgel.

skills.name: Piercing Harmony
skills.description: Increases the defense ignored by Humanity: As-You-Will Fan, Ground-Shattering Wave skills, Iron Fan Gale skills, Stone Tremor skills, Consuming Flames skills, and Humanity: Gold-Banded Cudgel.

skills.name: Boss Rush Harmony
skills.description: Increases the boss damage of Humanity: As-You-Will Fan, Ground-Shattering Wave skills, Iron Fan Gale skills, Stone Tremor skills, Consuming Flames skills, and Humanity: Gold-Banded Cudgel.

skills.name: Empowered Gourd
skills.description: Increases the damage of Talisman: Evil-Sealing Gourd.

skills.name: Guardbreaking Clones
skills.description: Increases the defense ignored by Talisman: Clone and Sage: Clone Rampage.

skills.name: Hasty Ghost Flame
skills.description: Reduces the interval between attacks made by the Seeking Ghost Flame.

skills.name: Empowered Degeneration
skills.description: Increases the damage of Scroll: Degeneration.

skills.name: Butterfly Rush
skills.description: Increases the Boss Damage for Scroll: Butterfly Dream.

skills.name: Hasty Vortex
skills.description: Reduces the interval between attacks made by Scroll: Star Vortex.

skills.name: Heaven: Consuming Flames
skills.description:
[Heaven Skill] Fans the flames of destruction. Can only be used while airborne.
Press the up arrow key and skill key again to link into Heaven: Consuming Flames (True), launching yourself further into the air. If you do not link into Heaven: Consuming Flames (True), it will link into Heaven: Consuming Flames (Clone), sending a clone instead.
Not affected by cooldown reset. This skill's attack speed cannot be increased beyond a set value.

skills.name: Humanity: Gold-Banded Cudgel
skills.description: [Humanity Skill] Summons the weapon of an ancient sage, delivering a series of quick blows to your enemies.

skills.name: Thousand-Ton Stone
skills.description:
Transforms into a thousand-ton stone and drops down from the sky to crush enemies on the ground. Can only be used while airborne. Can be used by pressing the skill key or by tapping the down arrow key twice.
Can only damage enemies that are in range at the time of casting.
Can be linked while you are using Heaven: Iron Fan Gale, Iron Fan Gale (True), Heaven: Consuming Flames, or Consuming Flames (True).
Right-click to lock command.

skills.name: Talisman: Warp Gate
skills.description:
Summons a warp gate. Press the skill key again while the gate is active to mark your location and teleport to the gate.
Use the skill again while near the gate to teleport back to your marked location.
Pressing up and the skill key while the gate is open will open a new gate while the existing warp gate and marked location vanish.

skills.name: Scroll: Butterfly Dream
skills.description:
[Scroll Skill] Summons a swarm of colorful but deadly flowers. While this skill is active, your attacks summon butterflies to attack your enemies.
croll: Butterfly Dream is unaffected by attack reflection, and targets the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Scroll: Star Vortex
skills.description:
[Scroll Skill] Summons a powerful vortex that absorbs the enemies' energy. Restores HP and MP to party members based on how much energy is absorbed. Use the skill again to make the vortex disappear, or use it again while holding the down arrow key to change the vortex's location.

croll: Star Vortex is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Anima Warrior
skills.description: The Grandis Goddess's protection increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Grandis Goddess appear.

skills.name: Anima Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Sage: Tai Yu's Miracle Tonic
skills.description:
Takes a sip of medicine stolen from your master's stash. Talisman Energy and Scroll Energy are completely restored after taking the medicine and aren't consumed for a period of time.
Restores Talisman Energy and Scroll Energy over time.
Not affected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Sage: Dream of Shangri-La
skills.description:
Transports you into a scroll featuring a beautiful vista, giving you a moment of respite in battle.
If you don't use the full skill duration, then this skill's cooldown will be reduced. Not affected by effects which which reset or reduce cooldown.
Can be used while airborne or while using 1st to 4th job skills, but can only be activated during the finishing hit of Humanity: Gold-Banded Cudgel.

skills.name: Sage: Tai Yu Clone
skills.description:
Transforms one of your clones into a clone of your master, who then proceeds to nag your enemies' ears off. Stuns targets.

Targets cannot be stunned by Sage: Tai Yu Clone or other skills again for 90 sec.

skills.name: Sage: Tai Yu's Miracle Tonic
skills.description: Talisman Energy and Scroll Energy are completely recovered and not used for a certain amount of time.

skills.name: Sage: Clone Rampage
skills.description:
Draws out the full power of Talisman: Clone, raining a barrage of clones on enemies. Greatly increases the Attack Power and number of clones created with Talisman: Clone. While Sage: Clone Rampage is active, the clones target the boss with the highest HP first.
Can only be used while Talisman: Clone is active. While this skill is active, Talisman: Clone's duration will not decrease.

skills.name: Scroll: Tiger of Songyu
skills.description:
[Scroll Skill] Summons the guardian of Mt. Songyu, a giant tiger spirit. Whenever you achieve an attribute combo stage 3, the tiger gives out a mighty roar to shake heaven, earth, and your enemies.

croll: Tiger of Songyu is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sage: Wrath of Gods
skills.description:
Call upon the gods of an unknown place and time. Temporarily increases your damage, with the gods joining in after every few attacks.
Use the skill a second time to summon the gods' full power in a massive attack.

age: Wrath of Gods is unaffected by attack reflection, and targets the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Sage: Wrath of Gods
skills.description:
Call upon the gods of an unknown place and time. Temporarily increases your damage, with the gods joining in after every few attacks.
Use the skill a second time to summon the gods' full power in a massive attack.

age: Wrath of Gods is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sage: Wrath of Gods
skills.description: Receive the power of gods to increase the damage of Humanity: As-You-Will Fan, Ground-Shattering Wave skills, Iron Fan Gale skills, Stone Tremor skills, Consuming Flames skills, and Humanity: Gold-Banded Cudgel.

skills.name: Sage: Three Paths Apparition
skills.description:
Through enlightenment, create a special clone capable of attribute combos. Excluding Clone/True skills, when Hoyoung's skills that attack directly hit, a clone appears and does an attribute attack for a combo that hasn't been currently done to finish the attribute combo. The clone's attacks cannot have their Final Damage increased by Scroll Energy.
Resets cooldown of one attribute skill among Heaven, Earth, and Humanity skills upon reaching stage 3 attribute combo while active effect is active. Prioritizes attribute with skill on cooldown upon selecting attribute.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sage: Three Paths Apparition
skills.description: Waiting to create a special clone that will realize parts of the inner workings of your techniques.

skills.description:
Enlightened by the harmony of all creation, uses enhanced Heaven, Earth, and Humanity skills.
When you combo a certain number of Heaven, Earth, and Humanity skills, enhance the next HEXA Heaven: Consuming Flames, HEXA Earth: Stone Tremor, or HEXA Humanity: Gold-Banded Cudgel and temporarily increase their Final Damage.

skills.description:
Reaches the extremes of heaven, earth, and humanity to end the chaos of conflict and reveal a new world. Heaven, Earth, and Humanity skill combos are automatic during the attack.

Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
